Package management.domain

Class Menu

  • java.lang.Object
    • management.domain.Menu
  • public class Menu
extends java.lang.Object
    This is a entity class contains information about menu.

    This class contains menu informations including these attributes and corresponding get and set methods:
    price: a HashMap<String, Double> contains prices of different dishes
    stock: a HashMap<String, Integer> contains stock statuses of different dishes
    rec: a HashMap<String, String> contains the path of the poster image and recommended add-ons. They are stored in two keys: "poster" and "addon".

    Author:
    Xiaotian Wang
